audience: Creators planning and publishing social posts from LinkSelf
signature: A wide glass frame with a compact direct icon rail, one-row calendar toolbar and a narrow schedule edge.
rationale: The owner-approved compact app addendum uses 16px desktop margins, 40px rail icons and 36px controls in the existing Figtree and azure identity. Settings uses horizontal tabs and full-width content; editor channel settings expand one row at a time with a live destination count. Source attribution remains discoverable in the footer. Theme overrides are gated to LinkSelf; upstream installs and native network simulations retain their appearance.
